summary: Wooden L-4 tower built 1932 on Lookout Mountain, Lewis County, WA; removed or destroyed 1968; sources disagree on the forest; no site description found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com place the site in the Gifford Pinchot National Forest; the weebly index lists Lookout Mountain, Lewis County, under the Snoqualmie National Forest. The sources do not say which forest administered the 1932 tower, so the story reports both.
The register says removed in 1968 and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968. The year agrees; the story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Only two detailed sources (register and firelookout.com) plus a short weebly index and the FFLA list; the 1932 build and 1968 end agree across them. No staffing, fire or access information was found, so none is written. The height of 10 feet is repeated by both detail sources and looks small for an L-4 tower; height_m 3.0 is recorded as the source gives it and was not checked. The forest name is unresolved. Do not confuse with the rentable Lookout Mountain near Marblemount in Skagit County, which came up in search and is a different site; it was not used. The brief's record (gone, USFS, 1,669 m) matches the sources, so no corrections are proposed.
